text:
emma: Kicking off notes for docs v0.11.1 — this release will bundle migration docs, SDK snippet parity fixes, a short known-issues section, and a changelog entry. Who can own final publish? ping @maya

maya: I can take lead on the publish checklist and the release blurb. Freeze for doc PRs by Fri 12pm PT. Drop PR links here and call out any copy + snippet parity concerns. :calendar:

sam: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5120 -- migration guide for embed-streaming deprecation, plus Python/JS snippet swaps. Needs review: I changed `client.generate(...)` to `rdw.text.generate(...)` in JS and `client.text.generate()` in py.

rafa: Will run the snippet smoke tests. Quick find: one example still uses `kestrel:openai/compat` in an older snippet file — should standardize to the new model spec. Also replaced broken anchor to /docs/perf/caching#kv-cache and updated redirect.

emma: Also include a short 'behavioral change' note about routing fallback. Draft copy: "Routing fallback now prefers latency-compatible model variants; this may change per-request result distribution and tail latency." Thoughts?

roger: Fine, but please strip any numeric perf numbers from examples (token counts, ms). Keep outputs generic or mocked. Users misinterpret sampling numbers as guarantees.

maya: Agreed. I'll scrub numbers and make example outputs generic. Also adding a tiny example comparing policy fields: ```yaml
route_policy:
  policy: latency
# vs
  policy: cost
```

sam: Updated PR with migration comment markers `// MIGRATION` and small inline note about contacting SE for Dedicated migration help. I also fixed a few stray backtick mismatches in fenced code blocks.

rafa: Note: Netlify sometimes creeps old anchors into sidebar cache. If we get reported 404s after merge, queue a cache bust and confirm redirects in /_redirects.

maya: Known-issues draft bullets: - Sidebar anchor cache can show stale anchors for up to ~5m after deploy (SSG cache). - embed-streaming deprecation: users on v1 should migrate to embeddings.v2 or request support for Dedicated. - Python SDK: `client.generate` aliases are deprecated; use `client.text.generate` to avoid ambiguity. Keep these concise.

docs-bot: Release checklist auto: 1) All PR links posted 2) Snippets pass smoke tests 3) Changelog entry added to /changelogs/0.11.1.md 4) Known-issues block included 5) Publish command `/docs release-ready` run by owner.

maya: I’ll assemble the final changelog blurb and push a docs PR for /changelogs/0.11.1.md by Thu EOD. If you add changes after that, add a one-line blurb to the PR describing the change for release notes. :rocket:

emma: Thanks — people doing snippet fixes, please run them locally and paste `✅ snippet tested` here when done. I'll sign off on the publish once checks are green.

sam: ✅ snippet tested (ran JS + py examples locally).

rafa: ✅ smoke tests passed for updated pages.

maya: Final draft slated Fri 11:30am PT; publishing window at noon. Ping me for emergency edits after freeze.
